images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Colonial Revi

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a hip-roofed two-storey foursquare re-sided in asbestos shingle, the full porch walled in with big picture windows and an iron rail at the steps; a low stone-edged flower bed along the sidewalk; a stone-faced neighbour close by

why.note: 1940s-50s asbestos-cement shingle sold door to door as maintenance-free re-siding
